caption:
Two seat cushions, same price tag, same fabric. Only one of them is still comfortable in three years.

The test takes three seconds. Press the middle of the cushion flat with your palm, count to three, lift your hand. Good fill is level again before you look back at it. Soft poly fill keeps the shape of your palm, and it keeps every dent after that one too.

Illustrated here so you know what to look for. Do it yourself on the shop floor, and press every cushion of the sofa, including the ones at the far end.

One exception. A feather and down cushion is meant to hold a dent. Fluff it and move on.

Keep this for the next sofa you sit on.
